'''Jokes''' on [[Decipher]] Star Wars CCG cards sit in a card's title, lore or game text and have no effect on play. They include nods to the films' cast and crew, references to songs, films, books and advertising, puns, Decipher in-jokes, jokes about scenes in the films, and gags that the card itself acts out. Hidden pictures and icons are listed at [[Easter eggs]], and titles that scramble real names at [[Anagrams]].

|-
| [[Mandalorian Mishap]] || [[File:JP-L-mandalorianmishap.gif|x100px|link=Mandalorian Mishap|alt=Mandalorian Mishap card]] [[File:SE-D-sarlacc.gif|x100px|link=Sarlacc|alt=Sarlacc card]] || "Most space-faring adventurers meet their fate with a calm, quiet dignity." || Film in-joke || The lore is ironic: in ''Return of the Jedi'', Boba Fett is swallowed by the Sarlacc during the fight at Jabba's sail barge.<ref name="wp-rotj">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Return_of_the_Jedi Return of the Jedi], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013031548/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Return_of_the_Jedi Internet Archive], 13 October 2026.</ref>

== Endor ==
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! class="unsortable" | Images !! Text !! Type !! Joke
|-
| [[Ewok And Roll]] || [[File:Endor-L-ewokandroll.gif|x100px|link=Ewok And Roll|alt=Ewok And Roll card]] || "Even an All Terrain Scout Transport cannot stand on all terrain." || Wordplay || The title plays on "rock and roll", and the lore on the "All Terrain" in the AT-ST's name.
|-
| [[Lieutenant Watts]] || [[File:Endor-D-lieutenantwatts.gif|x100px|link=Lieutenant Watts|alt=Lieutenant Watts card]] [[File:Endor-D-majormarquand.gif|x100px|link=Major Marquand|alt=Major Marquand card]] || "Watts' gunnery skills produce devastating results." || Cast and crew nod || The card shares its name with Robert Watts, co-producer of ''Return of the Jedi'', who appears in the film as an Imperial lieutenant.<ref name="wook-rwatts">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Robert_Watts Robert Watts], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260113182014/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Robert_Watts Internet Archive], 13 January 2026.</ref> "Produce" puns on his job. [[Major Marquand]]'s game text pairs Marquand with Watts.
|-
| [[Major Marquand]] || [[File:Endor-D-majormarquand.gif|x100px|link=Major Marquand|alt=Major Marquand card]] [[File:Endor-D-lieutenantwatts.gif|x100px|link=Lieutenant Watts|alt=Lieutenant Watts card]] || "Directed a counterattack against the Ewoks on Endor." || Cast and crew nod || [[Richard Marquand]] directed ''Return of the Jedi'' and has a cameo in it as an AT-ST driver, "Maj. Marquand".<ref name="encyc199">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 199. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="wp-marquand">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Marquand Richard Marquand], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026024957/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Marquand Internet Archive], 26 October 2026.</ref>
|}
